description: Get what a Fuse room costs and when rooms are free: for each room type in Budapest and Riga, the lowest and highest monthly price from the live listing and whether a room is free now or from which date, plus what the price includes, the one time membership fee, the deposit rule and the contract lengths. Give move_in to see which room types have a room free by then. Use search_rooms for single rooms. Read only: it never books, holds, pays, uploads or signs; the booking link is the room's page on fusestays.com, where the student books.

move_in.description: Optional move in date as yyyy-mm-dd, or yyyy-mm for any start that month: says per room type whether a room is free by then, and, where that start is priced otherwise (Riga spring 2027 set prices), prices the rooms free by then for a contract from it.

name: get_prices_and_availability

any_length_offer.description: Some rooms have one monthly rate for any contract length (Riga offer).

from_eur.description: Lowest monthly price of a room free in the next four months (with a move_in priced otherwise, the Riga spring 2027 set prices: free by then, at that start's price); when every room is booked for that long, what its rooms cost when one frees up.

free_by_move_in.description: A room of this type is free by move_in; null when no move_in was given.

free_in_next_four_months.description: A room of this type is free now or within four months; when false the prices are what its rooms cost when one frees up.

from_eur.description: Lowest monthly price, any contract length.

next_free.description: now when a room of this type is free now, else the first day one is free (yyyy-mm-dd), or null when the room pages say.

to_eur.description: Highest monthly price, any contract length.
Highest monthly price of the same rooms.

url.description: The city page with every room.

items.description: Day of the month a contract can start.

data_read_at.description: When this answer was built (ISO time), not when the listing was read: a city in saved_cities comes from the last good read, up to a day old.

failed_cities.description: Cities whose room list could not be read just now: they may well have rooms. Try again in a few minutes.

membership_fee_eur.description: Paid once to hold the room.

membership_fee_note.description: When it is paid and whether it is refunded.

move_in.description: The move in day asked about (yyyy-mm-dd).

saved_cities.description: Cities whose rooms, or some of their details, come from the last good read, up to a day old, because the live listing did not fully answer just now: whether a room is free, or a detail, may have changed.

title: Fuse prices and availability
